paragraphs.text: Vnwxt ( Vin for short) is a stylish Homunculus announcer from Kylem . He traveled to Avishkar to present the second Ghirapur Grand Prix .

After his extensive work commentating for the Spellslingers at Valor's Reach , Vin became Kylem's favorite host. He was a shoo-in for the role of emcee of the second Ghirapur Grand Prix. Adored by his audience and gifted by gab, Vin is adept at spinning dull moments and random chaos into quick witticisms and heart-racing epics for the ages.
